query: WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO authors(name, sort_name) SELECT 'Undo ' || $3 || g || repeat('x',480), 'undo-' || $3 || g FROM generate_series(1,$2::int) g RETURNING id) INSERT INTO work_authors(work_id,author_id,role,position) SELECT $1,id,'author',(row_number() OVER (ORDER BY id)-1)::int FROM inserted
